term: operating from itself at a time (OperatesFromItselfAt x t)
definition: OperatesFromItselfAt x t: x's operation from itself (q.18 a.3 co.: operari ex seipsis, non quasi ab aliis mota) is present at time t of the duration frame; for what is not in time, presence at t is read with q.10 a.2 ad 4. It is the timed counterpart of Operates (SelfOperationLife). In Lean a parameter B -> T -> Prop.
